justification: The agent correctly identifies SUP-001 as most reliable (100% on-time), but critically misreports the on-time rates for the other suppliers: the ground truth states SUP-002 (Northern Fruits Co.) is the worst at 0% on-time and SUP-003 (Prachuap Harvest) is mixed at ~50%, whereas the agent reports 24% and 25% respectively — inverting their relative performance and causing an incorrect ranking of the bottom three suppliers.
facts_found: SUP-001 Somchai Mango Farm is most reliable with 100% on-time rate
All 5 suppliers are present in the comparison
A ranking/verdict is given with avg lead times
facts_missing: SUP-002 (Northern Fruits Co.) is the worst at 0% on-time (agent says 24%)
SUP-003 (Prachuap Harvest) is mixed at ~50% on-time (agent says 25%)
hallucinations: On-time rate of 24% for SUP-002 (ground truth: 0%)
On-time rate of 25% for SUP-003 (ground truth: ~50%)
On-time rate of 33% for SUP-005 (unverified, likely also wrong)
